name: Dataverse MCP Server
description: Enables comprehensive schema and solution management for Microsoft Dataverse, including operations for tables, columns, relationships, and security roles via the Dataverse Web API. It also supports PowerPages configuration, automated WebAPI call generation, and schema visualization through Mermaid ERD diagrams.
